tactics.title: Taktička ploča
tactics.name: Naziv plana
tactics.namePlaceholder: npr. split na B sa smokeovima
tactics.noLevel: Učitajte razinu pod Pozadina / razina da biste na njoj planirali; bez nje ploča je ravna površina.
tactics.hint.select: Click a figure, waypoint, route, area or note to select it; Shift+click adds or removes, Shift+drag draws a box, Ctrl+A takes everything in this step. Delete removes the selection (after asking).
tactics.hint.place: Kliknite na razinu da biste ondje postavili odabranu figuru. R je okreće.
tactics.hint.throw: Click the thrower, then where it should land: the ring is how far this throw reaches, a landing past it comes in to its edge, and the arc is the real flight. The chosen utility appears where it lands.
tactics.hint.note: Click where the note goes and type its text; its colour, size and when it shows are set below, and for a selected note in Selected.
tactics.hint.erase: Click a figure, route, area, note or drawing to remove it from this step on.
tactics.hint.moving: Kliknite kamo odabrana figura ide u ovom koraku.
tactics.hint.finish: Enter, a double click, a right click or Esc finishes it; Backspace takes the last point back.
tactics.figureScaleHint: 1× je stvarna veličina; veće se bolje vide odozgo iz daljine.
tactics.label: Oznaka
tactics.clearConfirm: Očistiti cijeli plan? Poništi ga vraća.
tactics.file.bad: That file is not a board this viewer reads: {reason}
tactics.addStep: Dodaj korak; figure ga počinju ondje gdje su im završili putevi
tactics.valorant.failed: Karte nije bilo moguće preuzeti s valorant-api.com: {reason}
tactics.gizmo.title: Transformiraj
tactics.gizmo.hint: Povucite strelicu za pomicanje uz nju, kvadrat po njezinoj ravnini, sredinu preko razine; prstenovi zakreću. Držite Ctrl za prianjanje na mrežu ili kutni korak. Esc prekida povlačenje.
tactics.speed.source.official: Brzine iz objavljenih vrijednosti igre (vidi Brzine kretanja u dokumentaciji).
tactics.speed.source.approx: Približne brzine (izmjerene ili tipične; vidi Brzine kretanja u dokumentaciji). Postavite vlastite gdje znate bolje.
tactics.route.title: Ruta: {total} s, dolazak u {at}
tactics.timing.title: Vremena
tactics.timing.realTime: Play in real time (a step lasts until its slowest route arrives); either way no figure moves faster than its top speed
tactics.timing.hint: Vremena prate površinu i nagib razine pri brzini svakog načina za figuru; CS2 karte su u jedinicama igre (39,37 po metru).
tactics.timeline.title: Dolasci
tactics.tele.title: Usporedi s podacima mečeva
tactics.tele.hint: Učitajte CS2 tablice mečeva ove karte (ili koristite učitane podatke) da vidite koliko su brzo igrači stvarno stigli tamo kamo vodi vaš plan.
tactics.tele.error: Podaci meča nisu se mogli pročitati: {reason}
tactics.tele.speedsHint: Stvarne brzine u m/s, između uzoraka tijekom kretanja.
tactics.tele.noStates: Podaci nemaju stupce stanja kretanja (hodanje, čučanj).
tactics.tele.compareHint: Odaberite figuru s rutom ili njezinu rutu da usporedite njezino vrijeme s onim što su igrači postigli.
tactics.tele.compare: Najbrži uočen {fastest} s ({who}), p10 {p10} s, medijan {median} s u {n} pokušaja; vaš plan {plan} s.
tactics.tele.none: Nijedan igrač u podacima nije išao odande tamo.
tactics.hint.waypoints: Click a figure, then each waypoint: it walks them when played. With several figures selected, the route is the group's (each keeps its place in the group). Begun off every figure it is a free arrow.
tactics.hint.measure: Click points to measure the way through them in metres, with the time it takes running.
tactics.draft.finish: {n, plural, one {# waypoint} other {# waypoints}}{group, plural, one {} other { for # figures}} · Enter, double click, right click or Esc to finish
tactics.measure.label: {m} m · {run} s running
tactics.removeConfirm: {n, plural, one {Remove the selected item?} other {Remove the # selected items?}} Undo brings it back.
tactics.layers.title: Layers
tactics.layers.activeHint: New figures, routes, areas, notes and drawings go on this layer.
tactics.layers.renameHint: Click to draw on it, double-click to rename it.
tactics.layers.shown: Shown: what is on it is drawn and played. Hidden: neither.
tactics.layers.locked: Locked: drawn and played, but nothing on it can be picked or changed.
tactics.layers.duplicateHint: A copy of the active layer to work on; the original is hidden, and routes of figures on other layers stay those figures' routes.
tactics.layers.upHint: Move the layer up: its routes play over the ones below
tactics.layers.removeConfirm: Remove the layer {name} and the {n} things on it? Undo brings them back.
tactics.layers.only: Draw only the active layer's routes (the others still play)
tactics.layers.lockedActive: The active layer is locked: nothing new can go on it.
tactics.layers.conflicts: {n, plural, one {# figure has} other {# figures have}} routes in this step on more than one shown layer; the upper layer's route plays.
tactics.layers.hint: Put each squad, plan or alternative on its own layer. Hide a layer to leave it out of the view and of playback; lock it to keep it from being changed.
tactics.author: Your name
tactics.authorPlaceholder: Signed on saved boards and shared edits
tactics.autosave.restored: The board you left was restored from this browser ({at}).
tactics.autosave.full: The board is too large for this browser to keep: save it to a file.
tactics.autosave.none: The board is kept in this browser a moment after each change, where the browser allows it.
tactics.speed.top: Top speed {v} m/s ({kmh} km/h): no route, wanted time or move between steps makes it faster.
tactics.keys.title: Keyframes at {at} ({s} s)
tactics.keys.remove: Remove the key at this moment
tactics.keys.aiming: Click on the level where it should point at this moment; Esc stops.
tactics.keys.hint: Angles from the hull's forward, right and up positive. Pick the moment with the time slider under the view; between keys a value turns the short way, before the first and after the last it holds.
tactics.keys.offBoard: The figure is not on the board at this moment.
tactics.route.wantHint: When to be at this waypoint, seconds from the step's start: the way there is spread to arrive then, never faster than the figure's top speed.
tactics.route.late: Waypoint {point}: wanted at {want} s, but at top speed it gets there at {got} s.
tactics.checks.none: Every figure keeps within its top speed.
tactics.checks.title: Speed limits ({n})
tactics.checks.late: Step {step}: {who} cannot be at waypoint {point} by {given} s; at top speed it is there at {needs} s.
tactics.checks.slide: Step {step}: {who} moves to its next place without a route; at top speed that takes {needs} s, so the step lasts that long instead of {given} s.
tactics.checks.squeezed: Step {step}: {who}'s route takes {needs} s at top speed; the step lasts that long instead of its set {given} s.
tactics.timeHint: Drag to see the plan at any moment and to set keyframes there; ▶ plays from here.
tactics.hint.draw: Drag on the level to draw with the pen or the highlighter; for a circle click the middle, then the edge. The camera does not turn while this tool is in hand: fly with the keys, or turn with the right button.
tactics.note.startNowHint: Start it at the moment shown (the time slider)
tactics.throw.reach: Reaches {m} m on the flat (launched at {speed} m/s, gravity {g} m/s²).
tactics.throw.src.public: Real-world figures; the game may differ.
tactics.mission.replace: Put the mission in place of the board? Undo brings the board back.
tactics.mission.done: Read {units} units in {groups} groups, {airbases} airbases and FARPs, {zones} zones and {markers} markers; each side is on its own layer.
tactics.mission.map: Set on {map}: load that level to plan on its ground.
tactics.dcs.counts: {groups, plural, one {# skupina} few {# skupine} other {# skupina}}, {units, plural, one {# jedinica} few {# jedinice} other {# jedinica}}, {waypoints, plural, one {# točka puta} few {# točke puta} other {# točaka puta}}
tactics.dcs.base.patchNone: misiju iz koje je došla (nije otvorena)
tactics.dcs.nothing: Ništa nije promijenjeno: datoteka bi bila ista.
tactics.dcs.untouched: {n, plural, one {# skupina ostala je kakva je bila} few {# skupine ostale su kakve su bile} other {# skupina ostalo je kakve su bile}}
tactics.dcs.warnings: Što misija ne može primiti onako kako je na ploči
tactics.dcs.warn.retyped: {group}: jedinica promijenjena u drugu vrstu sada je {what}; provjerite njezino naoružanje i bojanje u Mission Editoru.
tactics.dcs.warn.airfield-dropped: {group}: polijetanje ili slijetanje na zračnu luku više nije na ruti.
tactics.dcs.warn.ground: {group}: {n, plural, one {# točka puta nacrtana na tlu preuzima} few {# točke puta nacrtane na tlu preuzimaju} other {# točaka puta nacrtanih na tlu preuzima}} visinu prethodne točke.
tactics.dcs.warn.removed: {n, plural, one {# skupina uklonjena: okidači koji je imenuju više je ne nalaze.} few {# skupine uklonjene: okidači koji ih imenuju više ih ne nalaze.} other {# skupina uklonjeno: okidači koji ih imenuju više ih ne nalaze.}}
tactics.dcs.warn.static: {group}: objekti na ploči koji nisu jedinice ne upisuju se.
tactics.dcs.warn.no-country: {group}: misija nema državu na toj strani u koju bi je stavila.
tactics.dcs.warn.new-air: {group}: novi let počinje u zraku sa zadanom količinom goriva i bez oružja; postavite ih u Mission Editoru.
tactics.dcs.warn.type-guess: {what}: nema vlastiti tip u igri, upisan je kao navedeni.
tactics.dcs.warn.fuel: {what}: zadana količina goriva; provjerite je u Mission Editoru.
tactics.dcs.warn.patrol-ground: {group}: DCS nema zadatak patroliranja za kopnene jedinice ni brodove; ruta se upisuje bez njega.
tactics.dcs.warn.sweep-ground: {group}: DCS nema zadatak sweep za kopnene jedinice.
tactics.dcs.warn.no-target: {group}: {what} treba drugu skupinu na ploči na koju će djelovati.
tactics.dcs.warn.state: {group}: {what} je stanje koje ova vrsta jedinice nema u igri.
tactics.dcs.warn.game-task: {group}: {what} nije zadatak koji ploča može upisati; izostavljen je.
tactics.dcs.warn.skipped: {n, plural, one {# figura nije jedinica (oznake, oružje) i ne upisuje se.} few {# figure nisu jedinice (oznake, oružje) i ne upisuju se.} other {# figura nisu jedinice (oznake, oružje) i ne upisuju se.}}
tactics.dcs.warn.start: Zadaci postavljeni da počnu kasnije od svoje točke puta u DCS-u počinju na točki puta.
tactics.dcs.warn.wt-task: {group}: {what} zahtijeva okidač u Mission Editoru War Thundera; ne upisuje se.
tactics.dcs.warn.wt-count: {group}: jedinica u War Thunderu jedan je let ili vod; {n, plural, one {# figura na ploči ostaje} few {# figure na ploči ostaju} other {# figura na ploči ostaje}} jedna jedinica.
tactics.dcs.warn.wt-player: Nema plave jedinice za igrača: odaberite jednu u Mission Editoru.
tactics.mission.openHint: Datoteka misije kao ploča: DCS World (.miz), War Thunder (.blk), Arma 3 (mission.sqm ili .pbo misije), IL-2 Great Battles (.Mission) ili Arma Reforger (.layer). Svaka strana ide na svoj sloj, a razina misije učitava se ako je ima mapa razina. „Spremi kao misiju” upisuje ploču natrag u nju.
tactics.mission.saveHint: Upisuje ploču kao misiju za njezinu igru: u misiju iz koje je došla ili kao novu.
tactics.mission.missing: {name} nije otvoren u ovoj sesiji: odaberite ga ponovno da biste upisali u njega ili upišite novu misiju.
tactics.mission.levelFound: Njezina razina, {name}, učitava se iz mape razina.
tactics.arma.where: Arma 3 čita mission.sqm iz mape misije (missions\<name>.<world>); .pbo misije ide u MPMissions.
tactics.dcs.warn.arma-task: {group}: {what} nema točku puta u Armi 3; ne upisuje se.
tactics.dcs.warn.arma-crew: {group}: nova vozila dobivaju standardnu posadu svoje strane; provjerite sjedala u Edenu.
tactics.dcs.warn.arma-loose-route: {group}: prazno vozilo ili samostalni objekt nema točke puta u Armi 3; stavite ga u skupinu u Edenu.
tactics.dcs.warn.arma-air: {group}: nova letjelica počinje ondje gdje stoji na ploči; postavite je u let ili na pistu u Edenu.
tactics.dcs.warn.arma-new: Nova misija za Armu 3 na {what}: stavite mission.sqm u mapu misije nazvanu <name>.{what} i jednom je spremite u Edenu kako bi navela dodatke koji su joj potrebni.
tactics.dcs.warn.arma-text: mission.sqm bio je binariziran; upisuje se kao tekst, koji Arma 3 čita jednako.
tactics.dcs.warn.il2-type: {group}: {what} promijenjen je u drugu vrstu; IL-2 zadržava svoj tip: promijenite ga u Mission Editoru.
tactics.dcs.warn.il2-task: {group}: {what} zahtijeva naredbu u Mission Editoru IL-2; ne upisuje se.
tactics.dcs.warn.il2-no-entity: {group}: nema entitet u misiji, pa se njegove nove točke puta ne upisuju.
tactics.dcs.warn.il2-new: Nova misija za IL-2: provjerite godišnje doba karte, oblake i naoružanje zrakoplova u Mission Editoru.
tactics.dcs.warn.rf-task: {group}: {what} nema točku puta u Reforgeru; ne upisuje se.
tactics.dcs.warn.rf-cycle: {group}: nova točka puta Cycle još ništa ne ponavlja; u Workbenchu odaberite točke puta koje ponavlja.
tactics.dcs.warn.rf-sf-route: {group}: točke puta slotova Scenario Frameworka samo se pomiču; dodajte ih ili uklonite u Workbenchu.
tactics.dcs.warn.rf-loose-route: {group}: samostalni lik ili vozilo nema točke puta u Reforgeru; stavite ga u skupinu u Workbenchu.
tactics.dcs.warn.rf-count: {group}: skupina u Reforgeru jedna je figura na ploči; {n, plural, one {# figura ostaje} few {# figure ostaju} other {# figura ostaje}} jedna skupina.
tactics.dcs.warn.rf-retype: {group}: figura promijenjena u drugu vrstu zadržava svoj prefab; promijenite ga u Workbenchu.
tactics.dcs.warn.rf-no-prefab: {group}: za ovu vrstu jedinice (brodovi, letjelice) nema standardnog prefaba u Reforgeru; ne upisuje se.
